demos.title: OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect
demos.teaches: Separate authentication from authorization: OAuth 2.0 grants an access token, OpenID Connect adds the ID token. Generate a real PKCE verifier and S256 challenge in the browser and build the /authorize and /token requests an SPA sends to Microsoft Entra ID.

demos.title: Reading a JWT
demos.teaches: Decode the header, payload and signature segments of a JSON Web Token, read iss, aud, exp, scp and roles, and see why the browser may read claims but never trusts them for authorization.

demos.title: Bearer Tokens on HttpClient
demos.teaches: Send a bearer token by hand with HttpHeaders, read the full HttpResponse with observe: 'response', and watch an echo API answer 401 without the header and 200 with it.

demos.title: Functional Auth Interceptor
demos.teaches: Move the header into an HttpInterceptorFn backed by an allowlist of protected APIs, scoped to the route with provideHttpClient(withInterceptors()), and prove the token never reaches a third-party host.

demos.title: Auth State in a SignalStore
demos.teaches: Hold the token in an NgRx SignalStore and derive claims, userName and isAuthenticated with withComputed(), so the session ends on its own the second exp passes.

demos.title: Guarding Routes with canMatch
demos.teaches: Protect a lazy route with a CanMatchFn that returns a UrlTree to the login page and remembers the attempted URL, so the protected chunk never downloads for a signed-out user.

demos.title: The Sign-In Round Trip
demos.teaches: Build the login page the guard redirects to: navigation only for signed-in users, a return to the attempted URL after sign-in, and a clear message when the session expires.

demos.title: Firebase Authentication
demos.teaches: Sign users in with the modular firebase/auth SDK behind a signal-based service, attach the Firebase ID token in an interceptor, validate it in ASP.NET Core against securetoken.google.com, and publish with firebase deploy.

demos.title: Microsoft Entra ID with MSAL Angular
demos.teaches: Register an API and a SPA in Microsoft Entra ID, wire MSAL Angular 6 into a standalone app with provideAppInitializer, MsalGuard and MsalInterceptor, and test which scopes the protectedResourceMap attaches per URL.

demos.title: MSAL vs Easy Auth
demos.teaches: Compare MSAL in the browser with the Easy Auth sidecar of Azure Container Apps: /.auth/login, /.auth/me, the session cookie, and decoding the X-MS-CLIENT-PRINCIPAL header your API receives.

markdownItems.title: Tokens are not secrets
markdownItems.comment: Anyone holding a JWT can read its claims. Only the API that validates the signature may trust them.

markdownItems.title: Allowlist the bearer
markdownItems.comment: Attach a token only to the APIs it was issued for.
